title: Ölçüm kaydı, depo: yirmi cümlenin WAV kaydını alan, 30 gün tutan, 'sil' deyince silen ve ölçüm aracının manifest'ini veren API
roadmap_row: Always-listening natural conversation, interruptible, in the owner's language (order 6, Voice and character; the missing half of the approved idea stt-engines-measure, ADR-0242: the instrument exists, no recording does)
goal: Proposal team/proposals/2026-10-02-olcum-kaydi.md, the storage half: a NEW package services/api/app/voice/measurement (this card owns its __init__.py) that takes the owner's reading of the twenty scripted sentences, keeps it 30 days on his own Cloud Core and hands it to the measuring tool. No page, no script, no intent and no voice tool is added by this card (services/api/app/voice/intents.py and realtime_sessions/tools.py are other cards' areas and are not touched; app/voice/stt_compare.py is read, never edited - it is measure-compare-from-core's). CONTRACT (identical in the three measure-* cards): the sentences are app.voice.stt_compare.OWNER_SENTENCES (twenty; index 1..20 in that order; never retyped anywhere). place is exactly 'ev' or 'ofis'. A recording is identified by (place, index); its file name is '<place>-<NN>.wav' (NN two digits). Audio is WAV, PCM 16-bit, mono, 16 000 Hz, longer than 0 and at most 30 seconds, at most 1 048 576 bytes. Kept 30 days from recorded_at (retention_days = 30), then deleted by the Cloud Core itself. API under the owner session, every refusal {detail: {code, message}} with a Turkish message: GET /v1/voice/measurement -> {sentences: [{index, text}], places: ['ev','ofis'], retention_days: 30, max_seconds: 30, recordings: [item]} where item = {place, index, file, reference, recorded_at, expires_at, audio_ms, bytes, sha256, browser_transcript (string | null), browser_engine (string | null), capture (object | null)}; PUT /v1/voice/measurement/recordings/{place}/{index} with JSON {audio_wav_base64, browser_transcript: string | null (at most 500 characters; null = Chrome's recogniser did not run, '' = it ran and wrote nothing), browser_engine: string | null (at most 64), capture: object | null (the applied microphone settings: booleans, numbers and strings of at most 120 characters, at most 20 keys)} -> the item; a second PUT for the same (place, index) REPLACES the first ('tekrar'); GET /v1/voice/measurement/recordings/{place}/{index}/audio -> the WAV bytes, content type audio/wav; DELETE /v1/voice/measurement/recordings/{place}/{index} -> {deleted: 0 | 1}; DELETE /v1/voice/measurement/recordings -> {deleted: <n>}, every recording of every place gone; GET /v1/voice/measurement/manifest -> {language: 'tr-TR', items: [{file, reference, recorded_where: <place>, ready_transcripts: {'chrome-web-speech': <browser_transcript>} only when browser_transcript is not null, browser_engine}]}, optionally ?place=ev|ofis - exactly the manifest.json app.voice.stt_compare.load_manifest reads, plus the two optional fields. BUILD: (1) service.py, pure of FastAPI, over the EXISTING app.object_store.ObjectStore (no table, no migration, no new dependency, no new Settings field). The ObjectStore has no list call, so the layout is ENUMERABLE: audio at 'voice-measurement/<place>/<NN>.wav' and its metadata sidecar at 'voice-measurement/<place>/<NN>.json' - two places times twenty sentences is every key that can exist, there is no shared index object to read-modify-write, and 'delete everything' walks all forty pairs so an orphan cannot survive. Functions: save (validates with app.voice.providers.wav_info / wav_duration_ms: PCM 16-bit, mono, 16 000 Hz, 0 < duration <= 30 s, <= 1 048 576 bytes; computes sha256, audio_ms, bytes, recorded_at, expires_at = recorded_at + 30 days; writes the audio, then the sidecar; a re-save replaces both and restarts the 30 days), list_items (never returns an expired recording even when no purge has run; a sidecar whose audio is missing is not listed), read_audio, delete_one, delete_all (returns the count), purge(now) (deletes audio and sidecar of every expired recording), manifest(place=None). The clock is passed in. A lock per process guards save / delete / purge. What is logged never contains the transcript, the base64 or the audio - place, index, bytes and sha256 only. A store fault is a 503 with a Turkish message, never a 500 with a trace. (2) routes.py: the calls of the CONTRACT on its own APIRouter under require_owner_session (the shape of app/voice/qualification/routes.py and app/team/allowlist_routes.py); the body is JSON with base64 (the API has no multipart parser and none is added); a body over the size bound is refused before it is decoded; GET /v1/voice/measurement purges before it lists. (3) app/main.py: register the router beside voice_qualification_router, the store being the one the application already builds (artifacts.store - grep object_store in main.py); in the lifespan, purge at start and once every 24 h in the shape the existing lifespan loops have, cancelled cleanly at shutdown - the 30 days are held by the server process on the host, never by a session (TEAM_PROTOCOL 9). The ADR (team/plans/measure-recordings-api-adr.md, the lead numbers it) states: the enumerable layout and why no table; the three purge triggers; KVKK - scripted sentences only, the owner's own server (Hetzner NBG1), 30 days, deleted at once on his word, never used for speaker verification (ADR-0171 unchanged), the recording is what the browser delivered with its noise suppression on ('the sound the system hears', not raw); that the release carries NO migration; that the spoken sentences 'Ölçüm kaydını başlat' / 'ölçüm kayıtlarını sil' are NOT built here because intents.py is in three other cards' areas - recorded as the open follow-up.
acceptance: Red first (the report shows the red run before the package existed). services/api/tests/unit/test_measurement_recordings.py on InMemoryObjectStore, one named test each: a valid 16 kHz mono 16-bit WAV for ('ev', 1) is saved and the item carries every CONTRACT field with file 'ev-01.wav', reference equal to OWNER_SENTENCES[0], the sha256 of the bytes and audio_ms from the header; the bytes read back are the bytes sent; a second save for the same (place, index) replaces audio AND metadata and there is still one item; each refusal has its own code and writes NOTHING (count the objects in the store before and after): not base64, not a WAV, 8-bit, stereo, 44 100 Hz, zero frames, 31 seconds, over 1 048 576 bytes, place 'araba', index 0 and 21, a 501-character browser_transcript, a capture with 21 keys; browser_transcript null and '' are kept apart (null stays null, '' stays ''); an item is listed on day 30 and purged on day 31 (clock passed in, no sleep); list_items does not return an expired item when purge did not run; purge removes BOTH objects (the store holds zero keys afterwards) and running it twice changes nothing the second time; delete_one returns 1 then 0; delete_all with recordings in both places returns the count and leaves zero keys; a sidecar without its audio is not listed and is removed by purge; manifest() fed to app.voice.stt_compare.load_manifest (after writing the files into tmp_path) loads without ManifestError and yields the same references - contract halves read each other; ready_transcripts is present only for a non-null browser_transcript; no log record of any path contains the transcript or the base64. test_measurement_routes.py through the REAL application object: every call of the CONTRACT with its exact path, method and shape; 401 without the owner session on each of the six; GET .../audio returns content type audio/wav and the same sha256; the sentences of GET /v1/voice/measurement equal OWNER_SENTENCES in order; a refusal is {detail: {code, message}} with a Turkish message; an ObjectStore that raises gives 503, not 500. tests/integration/test_measurement_recordings_minio.py on the dev stack's MinIO through S3ObjectStore.from_settings (real infrastructure, not NOT_RUN - TEAM_PROTOCOL 9a): save -> list -> read_audio -> replace -> purge at day 31 -> delete_all round trip, the keys checked with exists() on the real store, and the test cleans up its own keys. Mutation RED with sha256 restore from a backup copy, three separate mutations, each turning a named test red: the sample-rate check removed; the expiry filter of list_items removed; delete_all walking one place only. Full unit suite and the integration suite green with raw counts; test_postgres_coverage_ratchet.py passes untouched (no table was added). No file outside the area is changed.
evidence_expected: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: the red-first run, the unit counts, the MinIO integration run on the dev stack (not NOT_RUN), three mutation REDs with restore hashes, 40-hex sha. Nothing here is READY_FOR_OWNER on its own: no recording exists until measure-recording-page. The report states: no migration and no dependency (the release is automatic under ADR-0214 addendum 9); the owner's approval of this idea is his permission for twenty scripted sentences of his voice to rest 30 days on the Cloud Core; and the two spoken sentences are deferred until intents.py is free.

title: Ölçüm kaydı, sayfa: /voice/measure - yirmi cümleyi sırayla oku; sayfa 16 kHz WAV yazar, Cloud Core'a yükler, Chrome'un aynı sesten yazdığını da saklar
roadmap_row: Always-listening natural conversation, interruptible, in the owner's language (order 6, Voice and character; the missing half of the approved idea stt-engines-measure, ADR-0242: the instrument exists, no recording does)
goal: Proposal team/proposals/2026-10-02-olcum-kaydi.md, the owner's side: he reads, the page does everything else (file format, names, labels). The API is on main when this card starts (services/api/app/voice/measurement/routes.py). Read apps/web/AGENTS.md first: this Next.js is not the one you know. CONTRACT (identical in the three measure-* cards): the sentences are app.voice.stt_compare.OWNER_SENTENCES (twenty; index 1..20 in that order; never retyped anywhere). place is exactly 'ev' or 'ofis'. A recording is identified by (place, index); its file name is '<place>-<NN>.wav' (NN two digits). Audio is WAV, PCM 16-bit, mono, 16 000 Hz, longer than 0 and at most 30 seconds, at most 1 048 576 bytes. Kept 30 days from recorded_at (retention_days = 30), then deleted by the Cloud Core itself. API under the owner session, every refusal {detail: {code, message}} with a Turkish message: GET /v1/voice/measurement -> {sentences: [{index, text}], places: ['ev','ofis'], retention_days: 30, max_seconds: 30, recordings: [item]} where item = {place, index, file, reference, recorded_at, expires_at, audio_ms, bytes, sha256, browser_transcript (string | null), browser_engine (string | null), capture (object | null)}; PUT /v1/voice/measurement/recordings/{place}/{index} with JSON {audio_wav_base64, browser_transcript: string | null (at most 500 characters; null = Chrome's recogniser did not run, '' = it ran and wrote nothing), browser_engine: string | null (at most 64), capture: object | null (the applied microphone settings: booleans, numbers and strings of at most 120 characters, at most 20 keys)} -> the item; a second PUT for the same (place, index) REPLACES the first ('tekrar'); GET /v1/voice/measurement/recordings/{place}/{index}/audio -> the WAV bytes, content type audio/wav; DELETE /v1/voice/measurement/recordings/{place}/{index} -> {deleted: 0 | 1}; DELETE /v1/voice/measurement/recordings -> {deleted: <n>}, every recording of every place gone; GET /v1/voice/measurement/manifest -> {language: 'tr-TR', items: [{file, reference, recorded_where: <place>, ready_transcripts: {'chrome-web-speech': <browser_transcript>} only when browser_transcript is not null, browser_engine}]}, optionally ?place=ev|ofis - exactly the manifest.json app.voice.stt_compare.load_manifest reads, plus the two optional fields. BUILD: under apps/web/app/lib/voice/measure - (a) wav: pure functions that resample mono Float32 samples from the capture's rate to 16 000 Hz and write a 44-byte-header PCM 16-bit mono WAV (values clamped, never wrapped), and bytes -> base64; (b) api: a small client over apiFetch from app/lib/session for the CONTRACT's GET, PUT, DELETE one, DELETE all - it sends what the owner pressed and reports what the Cloud Core answered ({ok: false, code, message} with the server's own sentence for a refusal); (c) model: which sentence is next for the chosen place, which are done, the Turkish lines; (d) recorder: one take = open the microphone, collect PCM, stop, encode, upload - every browser object behind an injected seam (microphone, PCM capture, recogniser, clock) so vitest drives it with fakes. The microphone is the real voice path's own: BrowserMicrophone from apps/web/app/lib/voice/audio.ts opened with the constraints the rig gives it (read lib/voice/rig.ts and store.ts; they are imported, NOT edited), and the samples are taken from its `stream` - the sound the system hears, browser noise suppression included; the applied settings (BrowserMicrophone.applied: echoCancellation, noiseSuppression, autoGainControl, voiceIsolation, sampleRate, label) go into `capture`. The page never opens a second microphone: while the tab's voice session is live (isLiveState from lib/voice/store) recording is disabled and the page says why (ADR-0061), and the probe microphone is closed in a finally after every take. A take stops by the owner's press or by itself at max_seconds. Chrome's recogniser on the SAME audio: when the browser has SpeechRecognition, call start(audioTrack) (Chrome 135+) with a clone of the same stream's audio track, lang tr-TR, and keep the final transcript; the proposal says plainly this was read from a compatibility table and never tried with tr-TR - so it is feature-detected and guarded: no SpeechRecognition, a start that throws or rejects the track, an error event or no result before the take ends plus a short named guard -> browser_transcript is null (never ''), the take is still uploaded, and the page says in one sentence that Chrome's row will not be measured for this sentence; a recogniser that ran and wrote nothing sends ''. browser_engine is 'bilinmiyor' when the recogniser ran (this page does not set processLocally, so it cannot know which leg Chrome used - the SttEngine names of lib/voice/localMode.ts, never guessed) and null when it did not. The recogniser is never started on the default microphone as a fallback: that would be a second capture of a different sound. Under apps/web/app/voice/measure: the page at /voice/measure inside OwnerGate - the place choice (Ev / Ofis, 'ev' first), the current sentence large with 'n / 20', 'Kaydı başlat' / 'Bitir', after the upload the next undone sentence comes by itself; a list of the twenty with done / not done, the length in seconds, what Chrome wrote (or that it did not run), 'Tekrar' (re-records that sentence; the PUT replaces) and 'Sil'; one button 'Ölçüm kayıtlarını sil' that deletes everything with ONE press (owner rule 2026-09-18: no second confirmation) and then says how many were deleted. The page head says, built from the server's numbers: only these twenty sentences are recorded; the sound rests on his own server for retention_days days and is then deleted by itself; while recording, the same sound is also given to Chrome's recogniser, which may send it to Google; do not record while someone else is speaking in the room. The sentences shown are the ones GET returned - no sentence text is typed into the web source. A refused or failed upload keeps the take's sentence as not done and shows the server's sentence; it is never shown as recorded. In apps/web/app/voice/page.tsx add ONE Link to /voice/measure ('Ölçüm kaydı') in the subtitle paragraph beside the Çekirdek link - nothing else in that file changes (apps/web/tests/pages/discoverability.test.tsx and tests/uistate read it and must stay green untouched). ADR in team/plans/measure-recording-page-adr.md (the lead numbers it): the capture point (processed stream, not raw) and why; the one-microphone rule; the guarded start(audioTrack) and what null against '' means; one-press delete; that the spoken sentence 'Ölçüm kaydını başlat' is not wired (intents.py is other cards' area) and the page is reached by its link.
acceptance: Red first. Tests ONLY under apps/web/tests/measure (vitest reads nothing else for this card): (1) wav: a 1 s 48 000 Hz sine becomes 16 000 samples; the header reads RIFF / WAVE / fmt, format 1, 1 channel, 16 000 Hz, 16 bit, byte rate 32 000, and the data length equals samples x 2; a sample of 1.5 is written as 32767 and -1.5 as -32768 (clamped, not wrapped); a 16 000 Hz input is passed through sample for sample; base64 of the bytes decodes back to the same bytes; (2) api: the four calls use exactly the CONTRACT's paths and methods through apiFetch, the PUT body has exactly the four CONTRACT keys; a 422 / 503 with {detail: {code, message}} comes back as {ok: false, code, message} with the server's message; (3) recorder with fake seams: a take uploads a WAV whose header says 16 000 / mono / 16 bit, with `capture` from the fake microphone's applied settings; the microphone is closed after a successful take, after a failed upload and after a thrown capture (count the close calls); a take reaching max_seconds stops by itself; with a fake recogniser that returns 'ofisü bilgisayarında' the PUT carries that string and browser_engine 'bilinmiyor'; with NO recogniser, with one whose start throws, and with one that fires an error -> browser_transcript null and browser_engine null in each of the three (three cases, three assertions); with one that ends without a result -> ''; the fake recogniser's start received a track of the SAME stream the samples came from, and was never called without a track; (4) page rendered with fixtures: the sentence shown is the fixture's (a fixture with a made-up sentence shows that sentence - nothing is typed into the page); with three of twenty done for 'ev' the fourth is current and the counter says 4 / 20; switching to 'ofis' shows that place's own progress; the retention sentence carries the number from retention_days (a fixture with 7 shows 7); recording is disabled with its Turkish reason while the voice session is live; 'Tekrar' on sentence 2 sends a PUT for index 2; 'Sil' sends that recording's DELETE; 'Ölçüm kayıtlarını sil' sends ONE DELETE with no dialog and the page then shows the deleted count; a refused upload shows the server's sentence and the sentence stays not done; (5) contract halves read each other: a test reads the text of services/api/app/voice/measurement/routes.py and asserts every path the client calls appears there, and reads services/api/app/voice/stt_compare.py and asserts that NO file under apps/web/app/voice/measure or apps/web/app/lib/voice/measure contains any of its OWNER_SENTENCES; (6) apps/web/app/voice/page.tsx contains href='/voice/measure'. Mutation RED with restore from a backup copy, three separate mutations: the clamp removed from the encoder (case 1 red); the microphone close removed from the failure path (case 3 red); the recogniser's failure mapped to '' instead of null (case 3 red). Web gates with raw counts (node node_modules/... - never pnpm exec): vitest whole suite, tsc, oxlint; tests/pages, tests/uistate and tests/voice green and unedited. No file outside the area is changed; lib/voice/audio.ts, rig.ts, store.ts and localMode.ts are imported and not edited.
evidence_expected: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: red-first run, vitest / tsc / oxlint raw counts, three mutation REDs, 40-hex sha. PROVEN_PROXY at most for the page itself (fakes and fixtures; a headless Chrome run against the dev stack with a fake audio device if the inspector can make one - and that run is where start(audioTrack) with tr-TR is first actually tried: the report says in plain words whether Chrome accepted the track, and if it did not, that the Chrome row stays unmeasured and the rest stands). READY_FOR_OWNER after the release: on MAIL open /voice, press 'Ölçüm kaydı', read the twenty sentences once (about five minutes), see twenty done rows and what Chrome wrote beside each; in the office choose Ofis and read again for the second microphone; press 'Ölçüm kayıtlarını sil' when he wants them gone. PROVEN_REAL only from the owner's own report.

title: Ölçüm kaydı, ölçüm: stt-compare.ps1 -FromCore kayıtları Cloud Core'dan alır; Chrome'un kayıt anında yazdığı cümle tabloda kendi satırı olur
roadmap_row: Always-listening natural conversation, interruptible, in the owner's language (order 6, Voice and character; the missing half of the approved idea stt-engines-measure, ADR-0242: the instrument exists, no recording does)
goal: Proposal team/proposals/2026-10-02-olcum-kaydi.md, the last step: the recordings on the Cloud Core become the first numbers, and the engine the owner uses every day in the local mode (Chrome's recogniser, today the row 'NOT_RUN: no file input') enters the same table from the same sound. The API is on main when this card starts (app.voice.measurement). CONTRACT (identical in the three measure-* cards): the sentences are app.voice.stt_compare.OWNER_SENTENCES (twenty; index 1..20 in that order; never retyped anywhere). place is exactly 'ev' or 'ofis'. A recording is identified by (place, index); its file name is '<place>-<NN>.wav' (NN two digits). CHANGE 1, services/api/app/voice/stt_compare.py (MEASUREMENT ONLY stays true: no default, no provider registration, no Settings field, no dependency): load_manifest reads the two optional item fields - ready_transcripts (an object of engine label -> the sentence that engine wrote WHEN THE RECORDING WAS MADE; anything else is a ManifestError) and browser_engine - into Recording (new fields with defaults, so every existing caller holds). In run_comparison an engine that has no provider and whose label appears in at least one usable recording's ready_transcripts is scored from those sentences with the SAME score_pair and intent_changed as every other row: status RAN, a new row field source = 'recorded_live' (every transcribed row says 'file'), latency p50/p95 null (nothing was timed), files_ran = the recordings that carry a sentence for it, and a recording without one is that file's error 'no ready transcript' in the row - never counted as a perfect or an empty hearing; '' is a hearing (every reference word is an edit). Such a row is NOT in audio_sent_to (this run sent it nothing); the report gains heard_live_by: [{engine, destination}] and summary_tr one line saying that row is what Chrome wrote at recording time in the browser, where Chrome may have sent the sound to Google, and one line that the recordings are the sound the system hears (browser noise suppression on), not raw. The item rows carry browser_engine. REPORT_SCHEMA_VERSION becomes '1.1'. A manifest with no ready_transcripts gives the engine statuses, reasons and numbers it gave before (chrome-web-speech stays NOT_RUN / no file input); a label in ready_transcripts that no configured engine has gets its own row after the configured ones, so nothing recorded is dropped silently. CHANGE 2, scripts/voice/stt-compare.ps1: a -FromCore switch (parameter sets: -Folder stays mandatory without it and is refused together with it), -CoreUrl (the Cloud Core base; default resolved the way the other scripts resolve it - read scripts/lib before choosing, never a new hard-coded host) and -Place (ev | ofis, default both). With -FromCore the script: dot-sources scripts/lib/HttpJson.ps1, SecretStore.ps1 and AgentUpdate.ps1 and takes an owner session with Get-OwnerSessionToken (the caller's own environment variable PAGENTOS_OWNER_SESSION_TOKEN wins and is left alone, as the engine keys' environment does today); the token is never printed, never written to disk and never a command-line argument of a child; reads GET /v1/voice/measurement and GET .../manifest; when there is no recording it says so in one Turkish line, calls no engine, writes no report and exits 0; otherwise downloads every listed audio into a FRESH folder under the user's temp directory - never inside the repository - checks each file's sha256 against the item's and stops (non-zero, nothing sent to any engine) on a mismatch, writes manifest.json there as UTF-8 without BOM, runs the existing measurement on that folder unchanged, and removes the folder in a finally (retry the delete; a locked file is retried, not swallowed). The report and its .md go to docs/evidence exactly as today. The script works the same started with -File and started as '& script' (helpers are resolved, not assumed global), and no native command's stderr is merged into the pipeline (no 2>&1). If the manifest the Core returns needs a change to be loadable, services/api/app/voice/measurement/service.py is in this card's area; routes.py is not. Who runs it: the lead, after the owner has read (a scheduled nightly run is a later card - scripts/team/register-nightly.ps1 is another card's area). ADR in team/plans/measure-compare-from-core-adr.md (the lead numbers it): the recorded_live row and why it is not in audio_sent_to, null against '', schema 1.1, the temp-folder rule for personal data, the token rule, and that the report in docs/evidence holds the transcripts of SCRIPTED sentences only and enters the repository.

(2) three recordings of which two carry a sentence -> files_ran 2, files_failed 1 with 'no ready transcript', and the rates are over the two; (3) '' counts every reference word as an edit and is not an error; null / absent is the error; (4) the row is absent from audio_sent_to and present in heard_live_by, and summary_tr names it as written at recording time and contains no transcript; (5) a manifest without the fields: chrome-web-speech is NOT_RUN / no file input and every other row equals what the pre-card code produced for the same fake engines (the expected rows are held by the test);
